description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController that provides basic endpoints such as welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller exposing basic endpoints for a task management backend, including welcome, documentation redirect, health status, and info endpoints.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/' and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/docs' and redirects to Swagger UI, preserving the scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and returns 'OK' indicating the application is healthy.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/api/info' and returns application information.
